brief:
Israeli forces are targeting Palestinian security and police agencies in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported, citing what it describes as a strategy to fracture social cohesion and undermine law enforcement across the territory.

The reported strikes aim to disable institutional capacity and create conditions of lawlessness, according to the account. The targeting of security apparatus compounds existing challenges to governance and civilian protection in Gaza.

title: Occupation targets Gaza security forces to foment chaos
